name: fit the unique polynomial through all the points
mechanism: through n+1 points there is exactly one polynomial of degree at most n; construct it (by a basis of products that vanish at all other points, or by solving for coefficients) and evaluate it at the query

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Polynomial interpolation' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Interpolation and extrapolation:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Lagrange interpolation': interpolation using Lagrange polynomials

fails_when: wild oscillation between equally spaced points as the degree grows
